```{r}
mortality_dat <- read.csv("Adult mortality rate (2019-2021).csv")

mort_mod <- lm (Average_CDR ~ Average_HEXP... + Average_GDP_per_capita..., mortality_dat)


mort_mod2 <- lm( Average_CDR ~ Average_HEXP... + Average_GDP_per_capita... +
    relevel(factor(Development_level), ref = "Short"),
  data = mortality_dat)

summary(mort_mod2)

plot(mort_mod, which = 1)
plot(mort_mod2, which = 1)

shapiro.test(residuals(mort_mod))
shapiro.test(residuals(mort_mod2))
```
